Bill.BriefDescription: Limiting provocation as a defense for dog bites.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to provocation as a defense for dog bites; andamending RCW 16.08.060.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 16.08.060 and 1941 c 77 s 3 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Proof of provocation of the attack by the injured person shall bea complete defense to an action for damages, except when the injuredperson is a child under the age of six and, at the time of the attack,the dog is running at large or the dog is on the property of a personother than the dog owner, without the property owner's express orimplied permission.
